units.title: Activate and exercise the source outcome-admission consumer
units.objective: Make Plan 122 selected-outcome admission automatic and reversible at the actual Enforced Planning source bootstrap, lifecycle, and native pre-write boundaries without propagating to consumers.

included: Strict absent-off and enforce-selected source configuration
Canonical lifecycle source adoption at the real source Make boundary
Declared generated lifecycle mirror synchronization inside the source repository
Automatic configured session start, renewal, and heartbeat admission
Automatic configured native pre-write admission after ordinary authority
Authentic Plan 123 bootstrap, allocation, selection, expansion, allow, deny, and rollback evidence
Truthful source config, guide, plan, graph, evidence, index, and roadmap closeout
excluded: Installer execution against any consumer repository
Selection of Brian's active product outcome
OS-level or cryptographic resistance to shared-identity bypass

outputs: Automatic configured lifecycle and native pre-write enforcement
Authentic source activation and rollback evidence
Bounded normal-project promotion recommendation or rejection

acceptance.criterion: One strict production loader defaults source outcome admission to off, rejects malformed values, and drives both lifecycle and pre-write when enforce_selected.
acceptance.negative_control: A caller omission or explicit ordinary mode cannot silently disable configured selected enforcement.

acceptance.criterion: One unique-plan bootstrap resolver and sanctioned Make entrypoint create only an exact restricted bootstrap lane.
evidence_required: Ambiguous, mixed, empty, source, traversal, and foreign-plan denials
acceptance.negative_control: A source or test path in the bootstrap claim denies the bundle before protected work.

acceptance.criterion: The real source Make boundary executes the canonical lifecycle owner and source generated mirrors match their declared canonical sources.
evidence_required: Regression that would fail with the pre-Plan-123 stale mirror
acceptance.negative_control: Canonical-source unit tests or Make dry-run text alone cannot satisfy adoption.

acceptance.criterion: Configured session start/renewal and heartbeat require exact selected admission without outcome flags and deny before mutation on failure.
acceptance.negative_control: Omitting --outcome-selected cannot renew configured source work.

acceptance.criterion: Configured native pre-write preserves ordinary precedence, allows exact bootstrap or active selected work, and denies circular/missing/inactive state without outcome flags.
acceptance.negative_control: Changing approval text, elapsed time, or cost cannot alter the configured decision.

acceptance.criterion: Activation has one executable recoverable rollback and retains exact both-sign evidence without downstream mutation or adoption claims.
acceptance.negative_control: Evidence does not claim installer, fleet, host-wide, cross-repository, semantic-progress, or product-selection promotion.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Plan 122 is accepted; one exact Plan 123 lane first owns only bootstrap paths, then may expand only after exact allocation and selection admission.
